description: Submit a job by job type and wait up to waitSeconds (default 90, max 600) for its result, reporting progress while it waits. On reaching the bound it returns the job id and current progress; the job keeps running. Prefer the typed simulate_* tool for the job you want.

full.description: Return the whole result payload instead of the summary

inputFiles.description: Inline files for file-input job types. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY.

name.description: File name including its extension, e.g. "channel.s4p"

inputPaths.description: Local file paths for file-input job types. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait before returning the job id (max 600)

name: run_simulation
title: Run Simulation
